description: Hersteller-ID, product data and the ERiC runtime of this installation.

fields.description: On as long as no runtime is installed or no Hersteller-ID is entered: Prüfen and Testsenden only simulate, nothing reaches the Finanzamt.
fields.label: Simulation Mode

fields.description: Before ERiC is used, the Datenschutzhinweise of the tax administration have to be read and confirmed (§ 5 of the ERiC licence). Their text comes with the ERiC download from the ELSTER developer area. Without the confirmation, only the simulation runs.
fields.label: Datenschutzhinweise Read and Confirmed

fields.description: Five digits, issued to the manufacturer of the software in the ELSTER developer area.
fields.label: Hersteller-ID

fields.description: Goes to ELSTER with every case, at most 50 characters and without the word ELSTER.
fields.label: Product Name

fields.description: Who delivers the data, at most 256 characters: company; contact person; telephone; e-mail; town; postcode; street; country.
fields.label: Datenlieferant

fields.description: Name and seat of the manufacturer of the software, such as (c) 2026 Beispiel GmbH, München, at most 50 characters. Every Erklärung, USt, KSt and GewSt, carries it in its Vorsatz; without it, none runs through ERiC.
fields.label: Copyright Notice

fields.description: Set on the server as steuerbote_eric_archive in common_site_config.json of the bench: the absolute path of the ERiC archive for Linux x86_64 from the ELSTER developer area. Shown here, changed only there.
fields.label: ERiC Archive

fields.description: Set on the server as steuerbote_eric_archive_sha256 in common_site_config.json: the SHA-256 of the archive, 64 hexadecimal digits, taken once its signature is checked. Shown here, changed only there.
fields.label: SHA-256 of the Archive

fields.description: The HGB-Taxonomie of the E-Bilanz and the Offenlegung. Steuerbote ships no taxonomy: the operator puts the package of each version from esteuer.de on the server and names it in common_site_config.json of the bench, and Install Taxonomy unpacks it outside every site. Check Runtime reports each version.
fields.label: HGB Taxonomy

fields.description: Set on the server in common_site_config.json, such as steuerbote_taxonomy_6_9 and steuerbote_taxonomy_6_9_sha256: the absolute path of the package of the version from esteuer.de and its SHA-256, the one esteuer.de publishes. Shown here, changed only there.
fields.label: Taxonomy Packages

fields.description: Each version unpacked outside every site, with the package it came from.
fields.label: Installed Taxonomies

fields.description: Each week Steuerbote loads the Mindestversionsliste ELSTER publishes for ERiC and compares the libraries of every installed runtime with it. The System Managers hear once of each finding; Check Runtime shows the comparison.
fields.label: ERiC Versions

fields.description: The version of the list itself, which ELSTER publishes at https://www.elster.de/elsterweb/attachments/eric/eric_mindestversionsliste.yaml.
fields.label: Version of the Mindestversionsliste

fields.description: As the server of ELSTER states it (Last-Modified).
fields.label: Mindestversionsliste Changed On

fields.description: The Mindestversion of libericapi.so, the API library of ERiC, for Linux x86_64 in the list.
fields.label: Minimum Version of ERiC

fields.description: The Error Log names the reason; the next weekly check tries again.
fields.label: Version Check Failed

fields.description: Only where the server reaches ELSTER through a proxy. ERiC takes http://, socks4:// or socks5:// with host and port, a SOCKS proxy without user and password.
fields.label: Proxy

fields.description: Such as http://proxy.example.com:3128. Empty: no proxy.
fields.label: Proxy URL

fields.description: Kept encrypted, and handed to ERiC for a run only.
fields.label: Proxy Password

fields.description: How the System Managers heard of the latest new findings of the weekly check. Notification Only: no outgoing e-mail account is set up. No Recipients: there is no enabled System Manager besides Administrator. Not Delivered: the Error Log names the reason, and the next weekly check sends the notice.
fields.label: Notice of New Findings
fields.options:
E-Mail and Notification
Notification Only
No Recipients
Not Delivered

name: ERiC Settings
